scope: Acceptance links, not execution results. Exact build outcomes live in run ledgers. Partial inventory; not all UI paths covered.

IDE-005.contract: Named dirty buffers saved independently; untitled skipped and reported; write failure never reports global success; recoverable changes survive.

IDE-006.contract: Save/Discard/Cancel reviews the correct document; Cancel keeps it open and unchanged.

IDE-007.contract: All dirty documents reviewed; Cancel keeps IDE alive; clean exit after decisions.

IDE-019.contract: Real entries only; filter, Enter jump, Esc retains cursor; Delete does not invoke Ctrl+G.

IDE-020.contract: HBP parsed and preserved; opening never executes build hooks.

IDE-021.contract: Source desktop and build act on selected project; diagnostics target correct file.

IDE-026.contract: List marks dirty and switches selected buffer without crossing state.

IDE-027.contract: Real compiler messages list and navigate to correct source.

IDE-028.contract: Next diagnostic wraps with correct line and status.

IDE-029.contract: Previous diagnostic wraps with correct line and status.

IDE-033.contract: Literal arguments reach Start/Script/Debug; shell metacharacters cannot execute commands.

DBG-004.contract: Alt+X aborts debuggee, not IDE; colors/menu restored; next session clean.

DBG-012.contract: Application screen round trip restores debugger; visual buffer correctness still requires pixels.

DBG-014.contract: All statements execute and return to IDE; application nested display count preserved; visual tearing separate.

DBG-037.contract: ON enters extended block; OFF steps past; fresh sessions tested.

DBG-038.contract: Hide, temporary Alt menu, Esc rehide, Alt+O,M restore; explicit ON/OFF and settings round trip.

DBG-043.contract: ON/OFF affect real startup stopping in fresh sessions, not only check mark.

IDE-015.contract: Search next position case-insensitively; wrap within current and other lines; missing match retains cursor.

IDE-016.contract: Repeat visits adjacent and overlapping matches without double increment, then wraps.
